summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 4 features for Tramilex. All 10 features tested successfully: Company creates workers with extended fields, company uploads regular and signed documents, document review status visibility, admin signed-documents endpoint, admin sees signed count on workers, and company can delete workers. Backend (16/16 tests passed) and frontend UI flows fully functional.

minor.issue: Response does not include category field - need to fetch documents list to verify category was saved correctly

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended

passed_tests: Company login with CIF/NIF B99887766 and password
Company creates worker with ALL extended fields (name, last_name, nie, dni, passport, rut, phone, phone2, email, address, origin_country, residence_country, father_name, mother_name, children)
Company can list workers via GET /api/company/workers
Extended worker fields are correctly persisted and returned
Company uploads regular document with category 'identificacion'
Company uploads signed document with category 'firmado'
Company can list worker documents with status field
New documents have 'pending_review' status by default
Company sees reviewed status on documents
Admin GET /api/admin/signed-documents returns all signed docs across companies
Signed documents include company_name, worker_name, company_id, worker_id
Admin company detail shows signed_count for each worker
Company can delete its own workers
Existing worker Carlos Garcia Lopez visible with all extended fields
critical_code_review_comments: Upload endpoint response could include category and status fields for better UX - currently returns minimal response
DialogContent components missing aria-describedby for accessibility - minor improvement
seed_data_creation: Test worker TEST_Juan Garcia Lopez created and deleted during testing. Documents uploaded for Carlos Garcia Lopez worker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/companies/{id}/workers (company can create workers), GET /api/company/workers (company lists own workers), POST /api/companies/{id}/workers/{id}/documents/upload (upload with category param, 'firmado' for signed docs), GET /api/admin/signed-documents (admin gets all signed docs). Worker model has extended fields: name, last_name, nie, dni, passport_number, rut, phone, phone2, email, address, origin_country, residence_country, father_name, mother_name, children. Company login uses CIF/NIF as 'email' parameter in POST /api/auth/company-login.

Admin company detail shows signed_count on worker rows
worker_deletion: Company can delete its own workers

'Subir documento firmado' button present with green styling
